purpose: Treat an outcome as settled regardless of effort or choice.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
If we have to wait anyway, let us sit down.
It is raining anyway, so let us watch a film at home today.
Do not decide it is impossible before you even start.
restrictions: Can sound resigned or dismissive; どうせなら proposes making the most of something.
mistake: Use carefully when speaking about another person’s efforts.
